substantiveCommits.purpose: Add an Editor-update-based reflection-probe waiter so RenderProbe completion is observed after Unity advances instead of being assumed in the same call stack.
Split benchmark scene preparation from Camera.Render so reflection probes can synchronize between final scene rebuild and still capture without invalidating the cubemaps.
Make the complete native-4K review packet yield to the asynchronous reflection waiter and resume the sealed still/temporal pipeline only after completion.
Update the machine-readable synchronization contract to require later Editor updates and fail-closed timeout behavior.
Enforce the later-Editor-update observation policy in the reflection synchronization QA.
Add a second async-wait proof containing poll count/timing/RenderIDs and SHA-256 binding to the exact reflection completion receipt.
Require the SHA-256-bound async wait proof in the complete native-4K packet before and after still evidence sealing.
Record async-wait proof requirements, freshness, hash binding and failure modes in the machine-readable synchronization contract.
Require the async wait proof inside CapturePreparedSceneAfterProbeSync itself so legacy synchronous capture/provenance routes fail closed rather than creating authoritative stills.
Enforce async-wait proof path/schema/poll-count/freshness/hash-policy parameters in QA instead of leaving them as documentation-only contract fields.

technicalFinding.issue: The previous reflection hardening called RenderProbe() and immediately required IsFinishedRendering(RenderID)==true in the same editor call stack. That is stricter than fire-and-forget but can still fail before Unity advances the frame that performs a NoTimeSlicing realtime cubemap render.
technicalFinding.risk: The first real Unity runner could abort before producing any actual 4K evidence even when the probe would complete normally on the next Editor update. Conversely, accepting a same-stack completion assumption would weaken evidence integrity for glass/metal/reflection review.
technicalFinding.unityApiBasis: Current Unity 6 documentation states RenderProbe returns a RenderID and demonstrates IsFinishedRendering(RenderID) from later Update calls. NoTimeSlicing renders the probe entirely in one frame, which does not imply that the RenderProbe method call itself is a completed rendering frame.
technicalFinding.correction: The authoritative review packet now builds/saves/reopens the final scene, requests both 512px HDR ViaScripting probes, returns control to Unity, polls on EditorApplication.update while requesting PlayerLoop/SceneView progression, aborts after 30 seconds, requires finished RenderIDs plus created Cube textures, writes the normal runtime completion receipt, writes a fresh async-wait receipt SHA-256-bound to it, and only then renders hero/oblique/grazing without rebuilding the scene. The final Camera.Render entry also validates the wait proof so direct legacy synchronous paths fail closed.

verification.method: GitHub source/static inspection plus current Unity 6 Scripting API documentation review
verification.notes: Container-side git clone was also attempted for independent local inspection but network DNS access to github.com is unavailable in the execution container; repository verification therefore used the connected GitHub source API.

implementationReadiness.reasonNotIncreased: The remaining seven points are reserved for actual Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runner verification. Improving the evidence pipeline cannot substitute for executable verification.

visualFidelity.reason: No actual Unity 3840x2160 benchmark render exists. No visual category or critical defect may be cleared from source/configuration alone.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Lighting/shadows/reflections: removes a synchronization blocker and prevents merely-requested/stale cubemaps from contaminating scored reflection evidence.

Material/PBR physical plausibility: ensures glass Fresnel, aluminum/galvanized-metal highlights and wetness-sensitive specular review correspond to the exact current midsummer environment and scene geometry.
Cinematic image quality: keeps highlight/exposure diagnostics tied to the synchronized reflection state while awarding zero automatic points.

Critical evidence integrity: the official capture path and final Camera.Render now require a fresh SHA-256-bound proof that Unity advanced through at least one later Editor update before accepting reflection completion.
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 editor/runner. At first availability run NewTown/QA/Prepare Complete Native 4K Review Packet. First confirm the new waiter compiles, advances the editor, produces both reflection_probe_refresh_receipt.json and reflection_probe_async_wait_receipt.json, and reaches native still capture. If it times out or fails, repair runtime synchronization before accepting any render. If it succeeds, stop speculative expansion and score/fix actual hero, oblique, grazing and temporal evidence from the largest observed deduction or any critical defect.
